description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Compares two texts you send and returns whether they are identical, a similarity score, counts of added, removed and unchanged lines (or words or characters), plus a unified diff and hunks in line mode or a change list in word and char mode. Input: before, after, optional mode, context, ignore_whitespace, ignore_case (POST for long text). Limits: 200,000 characters per side (word 100,000, char 20,000). Offline.

after.description: The new text, up to 200,000 characters (POST for long text)

before.description: The original text, up to 200,000 characters (POST JSON {"before": "...", "after": "..."} for long text)

context.description: Unchanged lines around each change in line mode, 0-20 (default 3)

mode.description: Compare by line (default, unified diff), word or character

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

name: text_diff

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Text diff: unified diff, hunks and similarity of two texts ($0.002/call)
